grades.reason: Describes an rmem tool transition for modeling a late sc failure. It gives no practical causes of repeated SC failure in a retry loop.
Covers LoongArch bound-check stores (STGT/STLE), which raise a bound check exception. These are not conditional stores and have no link to atomic-update loop failures.

grades.quote: The SC must fail if the address is not within the reservation set of the most recent LR in program order. The SC must fail if a store to the reservation set from another hart can be observed to occur between the LR and SC.
grades.reason: Lists the conditions under which an SC must fail: the address is outside the LR's reservation set, another hart or device stores to the reservation set, or another SC comes between the LR and the SC. These are the main causes to check when an LR/SC loop keeps failing. It also notes that a hart holds only one reservation at a time.
Shows the standard LR/SC retry loop (sc followed by bnez loop) in C/C++ to RVWMO mappings. This is useful context on loop structure, but it does not explain why the SC keeps failing.
